description: This Java class, MiniLangElement, serves as a superclass for all XML element models within the Mini-language framework. It provides foundational properties and methods related to XML elements, such as tag name, line number, and tracing functionality.

classes.name: MiniLangElement
classes.description: A superclass for all Mini-language XML element models, providing common properties (like tag name and line number) and functions such as tracing messages.

methods.name: MiniLangElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the element with an XML Element and a SimpleMethod instance.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Placeholder method meant to update artifact information; intended to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the line number associated with the XML element, or 'unknown' if not available.

methods.name: getSimpleMethod
methods.description: Returns the SimpleMethod object associated with this element.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the XML tag name of this element.

methods.name: outputTraceMessage
methods.description: Logs a trace message with information about the element, including file name, line number, and tag name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the element, e.g., '<tagName>'.
